subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository approve `openai/codex-action` 1.11 for the three agent workflows, including the OpenAI-key-bearing performance workflow, as part of this grouped Dependabot update?
rationale: This is a third-party executable-action change in a secret-bearing workflow, and the repository policy requires direct Codex-source inspection before a safe merge recommendation; the correct trust boundary is a maintainer decision.

options.title: Split and audit the Codex action update
options.body: Keep the existing Codex-action digest in this batch and land 1.11 only after an owner reviews its exact contract and a redacted affected-workflow run proves the intended path.

options.title: Approve the grouped upgrade explicitly
options.body: Accept the 1.11 action revision in this PR after a workflow/security owner documents that the reviewed action contract is acceptable for the current credentialed uses.

recommendation.title: Split and audit the Codex action update
recommendation.body: Keep the existing Codex-action digest in this batch and land 1.11 only after an owner reviews its exact contract and a redacted affected-workflow run proves the intended path.

likelyOwner.reason: No concrete owner attribution was available from the supplied history, so the decision belongs with the repository’s workflow/security ownership path.
